replacements.Living Soak: In social form, use ordinary mortal soak: Resilience + eligible Armor against Non-Lethal/Bashing, Armor only against Lethal, and no soak against Aggravated damage. In hunting or war form, roll Resilience + eligible Armor + Archetype Rating against Non-Lethal/Bashing or Lethal damage. Every result of 6+ cancels one damage success. Aggravated damage bypasses Resilience, Armor, Archetype Rating, and Living Soak unless a separate ability explicitly grants resistance or immunity to that exact damage. Living Soak does not apply to Disruption, Pressure, Exposure, or Death Marks.

Massive Shift.effect: Cost: 1 Fury. Become Large for the scene. Add 2 damage dice to melee damage rolls, gain two dice to grapple or break barriers, and increase Carry by 3. You cannot benefit from human-sized cover, cannot pass through human-width openings without forcing them, and lose two dice from Stealth.

supersedes: The static Living Soak Protection bonus.
Any rule that treats Living Soak as automatic damage subtraction.
Any rule that reduces Living Soak because the character is at half Vitality or Wounded.
The Resilience option of Massive Shift.
Any temporary recalculation of Vitality, Protection, Exposure Limit, or soak from Massive Shift.
